intro.quote: All context establishment tokens emitted by the Kerberos Version 5 GSS-API mechanism SHALL have the framing described in section 3.1 of [RFC2743], as illustrated by the following pseudo-ASN.1 structures:

fields.name: thisMech
fields.explain: This field identifies the mechanism to which the token belongs.

cite.quote: thisMech MechType,

fields.name: innerToken
fields.explain: This field carries the mechanism-specific token. It starts with a two-octet token identifier and is followed by a Kerberos message.

cite.quote: The innerToken field starts with a two-octet token-identifier (TOK_ID) expressed in big-endian order, followed by a Kerberos message.

intro.quote: The authenticator checksum field SHALL have the following format:

fields.name: Lgth
fields.explain: This field gives the number of octets in the Bnd field in little-endian order.

cite.quote: 0..3 Lgth Number of octets in Bnd field; Represented in little-endian order; Currently contains hex value 10 00 00 00 (16).

fields.name: Bnd
fields.explain: This field carries channel-binding information.

cite.quote: 4..19 Bnd Channel binding information, as described in section 4.1.1.2.

fields.name: Flags
fields.explain: This field carries the context-establishment flags in little-endian order.

cite.quote: 20..23 Flags Four-octet context-establishment flags in little-endian order as described in section 4.1.1.1.

fields.name: DlgOpt
fields.explain: This optional field identifies delegation with the value 1. It is present when GSS_C_DELEG_FLAG is set.

cite.quote: 24..25 DlgOpt The delegation option identifier (=1) in little-endian order [optional]. This field and the next two fields are present if and only if GSS_C_DELEG_FLAG is set as described in section 4.1.1.1.

fields.name: Dlgth
fields.explain: This optional field gives the length of the Deleg field in little-endian order.

cite.quote: 26..27 Dlgth The length of the Deleg field in little-endian order [optional].

fields.name: Deleg
fields.explain: This optional field carries a KRB_CRED message.

cite.quote: 28..(n-1) Deleg A KRB_CRED message (n = Dlgth + 28) [optional].

fields.name: Exts
fields.explain: This optional trailing field carries extension information.

cite.quote: n..last Exts Extensions [optional].

intro.quote: Use of the GSS_GetMIC() call yields a token (referred as the MIC token in this document), separate from the user data being protected, which can be used to verify the integrity of that data as received.

fields.name: TOK_ID
fields.explain: This field identifies a token emitted by GSS_GetMIC() with the big-endian value 04 04.

cite.quote: 0..1 TOK_ID Identification field. Tokens emitted by GSS_GetMIC() contain the hex value 04 04 expressed in big-endian order in this field.

fields.name: Flags
fields.explain: This field contains attributes of the protected message.

cite.quote: 2 Flags Attributes field, as described in section 4.2.2.

fields.name: Filler
fields.explain: This field contains five octets with the value FF.

cite.quote: 3..7 Filler Contains five octets of hex value FF.

fields.name: SND_SEQ
fields.explain: This field contains the sender's sequence number in clear text and big-endian order.

cite.quote: 8..15 SND_SEQ Sequence number field in clear text, expressed in big-endian order.

fields.name: SGN_CKSUM
fields.explain: This field contains the checksum of the data to be signed and octets 0 through 15.

cite.quote: 16..last SGN_CKSUM Checksum of the "to-be-signed" data and octet 0..15, as described in section 4.2.4.

intro.quote: Use of the GSS_Wrap() call yields a token (referred as the Wrap token in this document), which consists of a descriptive header, followed by a body portion that contains either the input user data in plaintext concatenated with the checksum, or the input user data encrypted.

fields.name: TOK_ID
fields.explain: This field identifies a token emitted by GSS_Wrap() with the big-endian value 05 04.

cite.quote: 0..1 TOK_ID Identification field. Tokens emitted by GSS_Wrap() contain the hex value 05 04 expressed in big-endian order in this field.

fields.name: Flags
fields.explain: This field contains attributes of the protected message.

cite.quote: 2 Flags Attributes field, as described in section 4.2.2.

fields.name: Filler
fields.explain: This field contains the value FF.

cite.quote: 3 Filler Contains the hex value FF.

fields.name: EC
fields.explain: This field contains the extra count in big-endian order.

cite.quote: 4..5 EC Contains the "extra count" field, in big-endian order as described in section 4.2.3.

fields.name: RRC
fields.explain: This field contains the right rotation count in big-endian order.

cite.quote: 6..7 RRC Contains the "right rotation count" in big-endian order, as described in section 4.2.5.

fields.name: SND_SEQ
fields.explain: This field contains the sender's sequence number in clear text and big-endian order.

cite.quote: 8..15 SND_SEQ Sequence number field in clear text, expressed in big-endian order.

fields.name: Data
fields.explain: This field contains encrypted data when confidentiality is provided, or plaintext data followed by a checksum when confidentiality is not provided.

cite.quote: 16..last Data Encrypted data for Wrap tokens with confidentiality, or plaintext data followed by the checksum for Wrap tokens without confidentiality, as described in section 4.2.4.
